Apps_ConfirmText: {0} apps will be uninstalled. Local app data may be lost. A Store app affects the current user account. A classic program is removed silently where it supports that, otherwise through winget, and only if neither works does its maker's own uninstaller window open for you to work through. Selected settings changes will also be applied. Continue?
Apps_DetailCandidate: This app is classified as a bloatware candidate. Only select it if you do not need it. Uninstallation affects the current user account and may remove local app data.
Apps_DetailPersonal: This app is not classified as bloatware. Decide whether you need it. Uninstallation affects the current user account and may remove local app data.
Apps_DetailProgram: This program was installed the classic way, outside the Store. Bloatynosy tries the silent uninstall its maker supplied, then the Windows Installer, then winget, and checks after each whether Windows still lists the program. Only if none of them worked does the maker's own uninstaller window open, and from there it is yours to work through.
Apps_DetailProtected: Windows or the app's safety rules protect this component. It cannot be uninstalled here.
Apps_None: No app packages found for this user account.
Apps_Protected: This app is protected and cannot be uninstalled.
Apps_RemovedDetail: This app was uninstalled for the current user in this session. Reinstallation may be available from the Microsoft Store. It does not restore local app data.
Apps_RemovedProgram: Windows no longer lists this program, so its removal was verified in this session. Whatever the uninstaller left on disk is its maker's decision, not Bloatynosy's.
